message: The 3-task extension design (ObstacleTraverser-v1, Climber-v0, CaveCrawler-v0) was retired by Amendment 2 of docs/campaign_prep/ext/PREREGISTRATION_EXT.md. EXT_DECISIONS.json is kept unchanged as the preflight record (ext-20261023) and can never be used to plan or launch a campaign; launch evodevo/experiments/configs/campaign_a2.yaml instead.
